title: AI Gothic Art Generator
summary: Make gothic art with AI: cathedrals, stained glass, illuminated manuscripts and candlelit gothic romance. Describe the scene, pick a style, and generate.
body_markdown:
### What is gothic art?


Gothic art is the art of medieval Europe from the twelfth to the sixteenth century, known for cathedrals with pointed arches and stained glass, illuminated manuscripts and gold-ground panel paintings; the name is also used for the dark, romantic gothic revival of the 18th and 19th centuries.


### What are the main features of gothic art?


Pointed arches, ribbed vaults and tall windows that let in coloured light, stained glass held in lead, illuminated manuscripts with gold leaf, elongated graceful figures, and in the later gothic revival, ruins, candlelight, moonlight and melancholy.


### How do I make gothic art with AI?


Describe the scene with its gothic forms, one light source and a medium, such as a cathedral nave at dusk with a rose window throwing coloured light in a moody oil painting, then pick a gothic style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### Is gothic art the same as goth art?


Not quite. Gothic art is the medieval style and its 19th-century revival, while goth art grew from the goth music scene of the 1980s; both share black lace, candlelight and romantic melancholy, so a gothic revival prompt suits both.


### Can I make a gothic art video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe slow motion that suits the mood, such as a candle flame flickering, fog drifting or lightning over a castle.


### Is the gothic art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
